Senior Backend Engineer at NexusAI
Location: San Francisco, CA / Remote

About the Role:
We are seeking an experienced Senior Backend Engineer to architect, build, and scale our core platform infrastructure. You will work on real-time inference routing engines and distributed message processing systems.

Key Responsibilities:
- Design, deploy, and maintain high-throughput backend services using TypeScript and Node.js.
- Architect robust database models and execute zero-downtime PostgreSQL schema migrations.
- Optimize system performance, latency, and resource utilization across Kubernetes clusters.
- Mentor junior engineers and champion clean code standards and automated testing.

Required Qualifications:
- 5+ years building backend web services and distributed systems in production (required).
- Expert proficiency in TypeScript and Node.js backend development (required).
- Deep knowledge of relational databases, especially PostgreSQL indexing and query optimization (required).
- Strong written communication and empathetic collaboration skills (essential).

Nice to Have:
- Experience with Docker and Kubernetes container orchestration.
- Familiarity with event streaming platforms like Apache Kafka.

Lead Python Platform Engineer at PetalHealth
Location: Remote

Responsibilities:
- Build and operate HIPAA-compliant patient health records services.
- Implement robust REST APIs using Python, FastAPI, and PostgreSQL.
- Maintain high security standards, encryption at rest, and audit logging.

Requirements:
- 4+ years of professional backend development with Python and FastAPI (required).
- Experience designing and managing relational databases with PostgreSQL (required).
- Understanding of healthcare privacy regulations like HIPAA (required).
- Collaborative team player with excellent documentation habits (essential).

Full Stack Engineer
Must know React, TypeScript, and Go.

Frontend Web Engineer
We are seeking a Frontend Engineer to build interactive web applications.

Responsibilities:
- Build performant user interfaces with React, Next.js, and modern CSS.
- Collaborate with product designers and backend engineers.

Requirements:
- Strong proficiency in modern JavaScript, HTML5, and CSS3 (required).
- Experience building single page applications with React (required).
- Understanding of web accessibility standards (WCAG) (essential).

Telemetry Systems Engineer at OrbitSystems
Location: Boulder, CO / Hybrid

Overview:
OrbitSystems is seeking a Systems Engineer to develop ground station telemetry decoding software for commercial satellite constellations.

Responsibilities:
- Implement real-time telemetry processing pipelines in Rust and C++.
- Build high-reliability distributed event logging systems.
- Monitor ground station communication links and automate recovery procedures.

Requirements:
- Proficiency in systems programming with Rust or C++ (required).
- Hands-on experience with Linux systems and network socket programming (required).
- Demonstrated problem solving under time-critical operational constraints (essential).

Bonus Qualifications:
- Familiarity with aerospace telemetry protocols (CCSDS).
- Prior experience with SDR (Software Defined Radio).
